fullContentHtml:
PNB Bank LBO Final Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the final result for the post of Local Bank Officer (LBO). This recruitment was released for 750 posts. Applications for the PNB Bank LBO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 03 November 2025, to 01 December 2025. The written examination was held on 04 January 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their PNB Bank LBO Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 November 2025
  • Last Date : 01 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 04 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 26 December 2025
  • Result : 24 April 2026
  • Final Result : 23 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1180/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 59/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is PNB Bank LBO Final Result 2026?

PNB Bank LBO Final Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 01 December 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://pnb.bank.in/Recruitments.aspx

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
